 Health Canada and the Canadian Food Inspection Agency (CFIA) have issued new food and product recall notices for items sold through major Canadian stores and marketplaces including Amazon, the LCBO, the Wine Rack, Costco, T&T Supermarket, Farm Boy, Food Basics, Metro, Real Canadian Superstore, Fortinos, Loblaws, Valu-Mart, Your Independent Grocer, Zehrs and No Frills.
 Jackson-Triggs Cabernet Sauvignon Light 
 Issue Microbial contamination, non harmful (quality or spoilage)
 Where sold Newfoundland and Labrador, Prince Edward Island and Ontario, including through Amazon, the LCBO, the Wine Rack, Real Canadian Superstore, Fortinos, Loblaw, Valu-Mart, Your Independent Grocer, Zehrs and No Frills
 What to do Don’t use, sell, serve or distribute the affected product

 ARTICLE CONTINUES BELOW 
 Issue Undeclared milk

 Issue Lack of child-resistant packaging
 Where sold 24,950 units were sold in Canada from December 2024 to October 2026.
 What to do Immediately stop using, keep it out of the reach of children, dispose of it in accordance with municipal hazardous waste disposal guidelines.

 How to report an issue with a consumer product, drug, cannabis or food
 You can report a food concern or complaint to the CFIA .
 Consumers can report any health or safety incidents related to the use of products by filling out a consumer product incident report form .
 To report a health or safety complaint with a cannabis product, fill out the cannabis reporting form online.
 Report any drug or health product side effects or complaints to Health Canada.
